verdict.rationale: Mem0 supports scoping memories by user_id, agent_id, app_id, and session, which allows isolating private memory per user/agent while enabling shared retrieval across agents pointed at the same scope (e.g., shared app_id or agent_id), per docs-9 and docs-30. However, there's no explicit documentation of group/team-level ACLs, permission roles, or a formal mechanism to share a subset of one user's memories with another user/agent while keeping the rest private — the scoping is more about namespacing than fine-grained cross-entity sharing controls. missing for 10: explicit team/group memory sharing API or permission model, documented cross-user sharing controls, independent verification of tenancy isolation in production.
